completeCardUnchanged.name: No Escape
completeCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures marked by you within 60 feet
completeCardUnchanged.effect: While affected, a marked creature cannot voluntarily teleport, become invisible or enter extradimensional travel. If it willingly moves out of your Oath aura, opportunity attacks against it have advantage until the end of its next turn. This spell does not prevent ordinary movement, forced movement or planar effects explicitly stronger than the ward.

value.spell: No Escape — marked foes within 60 ft cannot teleport, become invisible, or use extradimensional travel; if they leave your aura, opportunity attacks against them have advantage until end of next turn

completeCardUnchanged.name: Verdict Absolute
completeCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One Judgment Brand target; witnesses in your aura
completeCardUnchanged.effect: For 3 rounds, your current Judgment Brand cannot be removed by an ordinary save or concealment effect. Smites against the branded target use maximum Smite dice, and it cannot voluntarily teleport or become invisible. If the branded target reaches 0 HP during the effect, restore your Lay on Hands pool to its normal maximum once, then up to three hostile creatures in your aura that witnessed the defeat make Wisdom saves; on failure they are Frightened until the end of their next turn. The Lay on Hands refill requires a meaningful nonsummoned hostile defeated in a real encounter; staged or willing sacrifices do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: Verdict Absolute — once per day, your Judgment Brand cannot be resisted: marked foes suffer max-dice smites, cannot teleport or become invisible, and if reduced to 0 HP you restore your full Lay on Hands pool; unmarked foes who witness the execution must save or become frightened until end of next turn.

completeCardUnchanged.name: Reign of Ashes
completeCardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
completeCardUnchanged.duration: Damage instantaneous; ash bonds until end of next turn
completeCardUnchanged.effect: Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2 S d6 fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing target becomes ash-bound until the end of its next turn: Speed is halved and it cannot benefit from Dash or teleportation. It retains its Action and Reaction unless another feature removes them.
completeCardUnchanged.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oathbreaker — Oath of Chains Broken
